== Unique Bows ==
<noinclude>
All bows now gain bonus damage equal to 50% dexterity instead of 100% dexterity.

See [[Class_Weapons#Bows|Class Weapons]] for unique Amazon Bows.
</noinclude>
=== Normal Bows ===
